title.zh: 谷歌向网络防御者限量开放 Gemini 4 Argon
title.en: Google gates Gemini 4 Argon release to cyber defenders

summary.zh: 据多家AI日报汇总，谷歌10月1日向网络安全防御方有限开放 Gemini 4 Argon，支持百万token输出并提供试行API定价。
summary.en: AI briefings reported Google released Gemini 4 Argon on a gated basis to cyber defenders on Oct. 1, with 1M-token outputs and introductory API pricing.

title.zh: 美国FTC对OpenAI、Anthropic等AI实验室展开安全调查
title.en: FTC opens industry-wide AI safety probe

summary.zh: 美国联邦贸易委员会开启一项涉及OpenAI、Anthropic等多家AI实验室的行业安全调查；加州同日签署涉及AI裁员透明度的法律。
summary.en: The US Federal Trade Commission opened a safety investigation spanning OpenAI, Anthropic and other labs; California also signed laws on AI-driven firings and layoffs.

title.zh: 迪拜飞往特拉维夫航班驾驶舱内发生持刀袭击后备降沙特
title.en: Flydubai flight to Tel Aviv diverts to Saudi Arabia after cockpit attack

summary.zh: Flydubai FZ1073航班驾驶舱内发生冲突，飞机紧急下降后备降沙特塔布克，全体乘客和机组安全，动机仍在调查。
summary.en: An altercation in the cockpit of Flydubai flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv led to an emergency descent and diversion to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia; all aboard were safe and the motive is under investigation.

body.zh:
据阿纳多卢通讯社报道，Flydubai 表示，由迪拜飞往本-古里安机场的 FZ1073 航班“驾驶舱内发生冲突”，机组成员控制住局面并将飞机安全备降沙特塔布克。

《纽约时报》称，冲突中有人被刺伤，飞机一度急剧下降，乘客极度恐慌。航空公司表示事件原因和动机尚不清楚，已展开正式调查。
body.en:
According to [Anadolu](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/morning-briefing-oct-1-2026/4074422), Flydubai said "an altercation occurred in the flight deck" of FZ1073 and the crew secured the aircraft and diverted safely to Tabuk.

[The New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/issue/todayspaper/2026/10/01/todays-new-york-times) reported a stabbing and a terrifying plunge before the landing. The airline said the motive is unknown and under formal investigation.

title.zh: 美军撤离伊拉克，结束二十余年军事存在
title.en: US forces leave Iraq after more than two decades

summary.zh: 特朗普宣布最后一批美军撤离伊拉克；伊拉克总理同日宣布美国主导的国际反“伊斯兰国”联盟任务结束。
summary.en: Trump announced the last American forces are leaving Iraq, and Iraq's prime minister declared the end of the US-led coalition mission against IS.

title.zh: 死刑犯注射后存活，美国田纳西州暂停执行死刑
title.en: Tennessee halts executions after prisoner survives lethal injection

summary.zh: 田纳西州死刑犯克里斯塔·派克在注射执行后仍存活，该州随即叫停其余死刑执行。
summary.en: Tennessee halted remaining executions after condemned prisoner Christa Pike survived lethal injections.

title.zh: 美债收益率触及24年高点后回落，美股小幅收涨
title.en: Stocks edge higher as Treasury yields retreat from 24-year high

summary.zh: 10月1日美债收益率一度升至约5.34%的24年高点后回落，标普500指数涨0.2%至7666.45点。
summary.en: Treasury yields hit a 24-year high near 5.34% before easing on Oct. 1, and the S&P 500 rose 0.2% to 7,666.45.

title.zh: 《纽约时报》：Meta借AI数据中心规避数十亿美元联邦税
title.en: NYT: Meta uses AI data centers to avoid billions in federal taxes

summary.zh: 《纽约时报》独家报道称，Meta利用AI数据中心相关的税收优惠规避了数十亿美元联邦税款。
summary.en: A New York Times exclusive reported that Meta is exploiting tax breaks tied to AI data centers to avoid billions in federal taxes.

title.zh: 卡内基梅隆大学获30亿美元捐赠，创美国纪录

summary.zh: 卡内基梅隆大学获得一笔30亿美元捐赠，NPR称这是美国历史上最大的单笔高校捐赠。
summary.en: Carnegie Mellon University received a $3 billion gift, which NPR described as the largest in US history.

title.zh: 新中国成立77周年 天安门广场举行国庆升旗仪式
title.en: China marks 77th National Day with Tiananmen flag-raising

summary.zh: 10月1日天安门广场举行国庆升旗仪式，各地开展庆祝活动，国庆假期出行迎来创纪录高峰。
summary.en: A National Day flag-raising ceremony was held at Tiananmen Square on Oct. 1 as China marked its 77th anniversary amid a record travel rush.

body.zh:
据央广网报道，10月1日清晨天安门广场举行庆祝新中国成立77周年升旗仪式，大批群众前往观礼。

据[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-10-01/China-celebrates-77th-National-Day-with-record-travel-rush-1QTlhURguVG/index.html)报道，全国多地举办庆祝活动，国庆长假出行规模创下纪录。

title.zh: 国庆假期首日迎出行高峰 交通部门全力保障
title.en: Holiday travel peaks on first day of National Day break

summary.zh: 中国政府网称，假期首日跨区域人员流动规模大，铁路、公路客流集中，小客车高速通行免费。
summary.en: China's government portal said the first day of the holiday saw heavy cross-regional travel, with toll-free expressways for small passenger cars.
